NEEDS_FIX: YES
<assessment>SOURCE panels show one elongated building with a recessed lower frame, projecting two-level glazed buffer, exterior ramps, a raised concave timber roof, partial intermediate floors and circular stair/opening features. Exterior perspectives, interior views, plans, sections and exploded diagrams share these landmarks. CURRENT captures the broad massing but differs in ramp routing, interior floor configuration and opening assemblies. No confirmed dimensions are supplied. CURRENT exterior “section” views and roof-covered plans cannot verify hidden construction or concealed joints.</assessment>
<issue priority="1" view="source-matched 坡道端">problem: SOURCE 1–2 show successive visible ramp flights descending toward the same side beneath the asymmetric roof landmark. CURRENT 15/22 instead places alternating diagonal flights across the exposed end, changing the defining circulation elevation.
action: Locally reroute the affected flights and return landings using the source end views and plans together; connect each flight flush to its receiving deck and remove unsupported projecting tails.</issue>
<issue priority="2" view="source-matched 首段及底层">problem: SOURCE 4–5/7–8 show a substantial double-height interior beside a partial intermediate floor. CURRENT 17/19 shows repeated floor and beam bands across that region, making the interior read as uniformly stacked storeys.
action: Correct the intermediate slab extent and associated beams to preserve the source double-height opening. Verify the resulting configuration with an actual section through the matching location.</issue>
<issue priority="3" view="source-matched 顶层室内">problem: SOURCE 4 shows circular floor openings enclosed by cylindrical mesh guards. CURRENT 18 has two visibly unguarded holes and a long gray strip crossing the floor and opening edges, with no corresponding source feature.
action: Complete the guards around the source-backed openings and remove or resolve the crossing strip so floor edges, stair access and guards form coherent assemblies.</issue>
<keep>Concave roof-edge profile with one side higher than the other.
Raised roof volume inset from the outer rectangular buffer enclosure.
Recessed lower columns beneath the projecting perimeter decks.</keep>
